title: Green Jobs Are Growing — Who's Actually Being Hired?

body.en: Solar installation, e-waste recycling, and climate data work are among the fastest-growing job categories tied to Ghana's green economy. Yeboah, who has a mobility impairment, applied to eleven of these roles before landing one — not because he lacked the skills, but because most listings assumed physical requirements that had nothing to do with the actual job, like a solar-data-analysis role that was advertised as requiring the ability to climb rooftops. The twelfth employer looked at what the job actually needed, adjusted one requirement, and hired him. The green economy is growing fast. Whether it grows accessibly is still being decided, one job listing at a time.

followUpQuestion: What was actually blocking Yeboah from the first eleven roles he applied to?
